name: Exp_i-AnyRangeCldTail_System_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA implements an i-AnyRangeCldTail trading system with time management features. It identifies range-based cloud and tail formations to enter breakout trades, enhanced by time filters to restrict trading to specific sessions. The 'Plus' suffix indicates additional features such as trailing stops, breakeven logic, or money management overlays on the core breakout strategy.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了i-AnyRangeCldTail交易系统并附加时间管理功能。它通过识别基于区间的云形态和尾形态来进入突破交易，同时利用时间过滤器将交易限制在特定时段。'Plus'后缀表示在核心突破策略上增加了移动止损、保本逻辑或资金管理等附加功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于AnyRange区间识别云形态(Cloud)和尾形态(Tail)的突破交易系统。入场条件为：价格在特定区间内形成云形态或尾形态后突破关键价位时开仓，多头在价格向上突破时入场，空头在向下突破时入场。出场条件包括：达到固定止盈目标、触发止损、移动止损追踪或保本平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA通过时间管理器(Time Manager)限制交易时段，避免在低流动性或高波动性时段交易。附加的Plus功能可能包括移动止损、保本功能和多种出场机制的组合，以提升策略的风险调整收益。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a breakout trading system based on the i-AnyRange range identification of Cloud and Tail formations. Entry conditions: positions are opened when price breaks through key levels after forming Cloud or Tail patterns within a defined range, with longs entered on upward breakouts and shorts on downward breakouts. Exit conditions include reaching fixed take-profit targets, hitting stop-loss levels, trailing stop activation, or breakeven closure. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity. Money management is enhanced by a Time Manager that restricts trading to specific sessions, avoiding low-liquidity or high-volatility periods. The Plus features likely include trailing stops, breakeven functionality, and multiple exit mechanisms combined to improve the strategy's risk-adjusted returns.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size, used when MMRec is disabled

pros: 结合形态识别与突破策略，入场逻辑有技术依据
时间管理器避免不利时段交易，降低隔夜和低流动性风险
多种出场机制（止损、止盈、移动止损、保本）提供灵活的风险控制
区间识别方法适应市场波动变化，动态调整突破阈值
Plus版本功能增强，提供比基础版更完善的风险管理
pros_en: Combines pattern recognition with breakout strategy, providing technically grounded entry logic
Time Manager avoids unfavorable trading sessions, reducing overnight and low-liquidity risk
Multiple exit mechanisms (SL, TP, trailing stop, breakeven) provide flexible risk control
Range identification adapts to market volatility changes with dynamic breakout thresholds
Plus version offers enhanced features with more comprehensive risk management than the base version
cons: 突破策略在震荡市中容易产生假突破导致连续亏损
形态识别参数(Cloud/Tail阈值)可能需要针对不同品种优化，缺乏自适应性
时间过滤器的固定时段设置可能不适用于所有交易时段和夏令时/冬令时切换
缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑，仓位管理较为简单
对滑点和点差敏感，突破入场时可能遭遇不利成交
cons_en: Breakout strategy is prone to false breakouts in ranging/choppy markets, leading to consecutive losses
Pattern recognition parameters (Cloud/Tail thresholds) may need optimization per instrument, lacking adaptability
Fixed time session settings may not suit all trading sessions or daylight saving time transitions
Lacks position scaling (add/reduce) logic, making position sizing relatively simplistic
Sensitive to slippage and spread, breakout entries may suffer unfavorable fills
improvements: 增加自适应参数优化机制，根据市场状态动态调整云形态和尾形态阈值
加入波动率过滤器（如ATR），在低波动率环境下减少交易频率
引入假突破过滤机制，如要求突破后回测确认再入场
improvements_en: Add adaptive parameter optimization to dynamically adjust Cloud and Tail thresholds based on market conditions
Incorporate a volatility filter (e.g., ATR) to reduce trading frequency in low-volatility environments
Introduce false breakout filtering, such as requiring a retest confirmation after the initial breakout before entry

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡市中假突破风险较高，可能导致连续止损
时间过滤器如果设置不当可能错过重要行情或在不适宜时段开仓
缺乏最大回撤控制和日内亏损限额保护
risk_points_en: Breakout strategy carries high false breakout risk in choppy markets, potentially leading to consecutive stop-losses
Improper time filter settings may miss important moves or open positions during unsuitable sessions
Lacks maximum drawdown control and daily loss limit protection
